decision: No concrete player-visible regression found within the inspected adaptive-quality, HUD-throttling and static-cache paths. This is a bounded source review, not whole-app certification or a fresh test pass.

findings.observation: Thirty eligible quiet preparation observations establish one frozen median baseline. Active loaded gameplay cannot replace it. Cheap regular slower cadence is not itself an overload; measured work/tail or sufficiently populated irregular delivery can request decorative relief. Downgrade requires two consecutive windows and a ten-second dwell; restoration requires headroom and a safe transition.
findings.control: solo-render-submission.test.mjs:348–395 exercises real host submission under steady30Hz and irregular callbacks, exact authoritative checkpoints, no restoration during play and public Resume restoration. Preparation/policy controls also cover rejected samples, cadence rates, work tails, interruption resets and preference floor.

findings.observation: Lives/coverage/score/status/ammo and other structural changes bypass the100ms gate. Accepted events mark hudDirty before the same callback's refresh; encounter phase changes emit events. Clock-only refresh remains bounded at100ms when unchanged.
findings.control: hud-status-cues.test.mjs:193–208 inspects the accepted capture callback. hud-numeric-values.test.mjs checks actual legal capture score, exact saved/replayed state and immediate locale changes.
findings.limit: The numeric test pauses before its score assertion, so it does not independently prove sub100ms damage/score delivery. Source ordering supports that behavior; no new timing control was executed.

findings.observation: Cell cache compares every byte and geometry rather than aggregate coverage, rebuilding covered runs/walls/boundary paths on differences. Terrain dependencies include coordinates/kind, relevant palette values and sprite assets. Layer size changes retire storage; look/level invalidation clears layers.
findings.control: render-performance.test.mjs:59–79 covers capture, erosion, equal-coverage swaps, geometry changes and authority preservation. Existing terrain/presentation controls inspect readable geometry and art placement.
findings.limit: These modeled operations establish invalidation/ordering, not native raster equivalence.

findings.observation: Static picture cache includes source identity/dimensions/fit; mutable filtered canvases bypass that cache. Logical and CSS geometry invalidate the displayed board. Theme/ground preference changes invalidate paused rendering, with ground.prepare replacing its surface when its key changes. Unchanged paused display retains pixels while input/UI polling still occurs before draw suppression.
findings.control: solo-render-submission.test.mjs:201–345 covers paused reuse, resize, dirty repaint and display preference changes without advancing authority or resuming steady compositing; solo-cadence-readiness-host.test.mjs:254–298 covers late paint followed by prepared submission.

remaining: Native concealment/hazard raster comparisons, equal-coverage layout/erosion pixels, picture transitions and resize/orientation qualification.
Matched sustained application-cost and cadence measurements; source comparisons do not establish achieved frame budgets or adaptation effectiveness.
Physical iPhone17Pro Safari and SteamDeckOLED Chrome qualification; neither device was used.
Existing failed or inconclusive native evidence remains unchanged.
retention: One remote audit blob only, explicitly requested by root after the read-only review.
